question: Should maintainers wait for this contributor branch to be refreshed and proven, or replace it with a credited current-main fix for the linked hook accountId bug?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the PR has useful work, but the branch is unmergeable, not maintainer-editable, and missing real behavior proof that automation cannot supply for the contributor's setup.

options.title: Replace on current main
options.body: Rebuild the narrow fix on a maintainer-editable branch, credit this PR and the linked issue, and require live redacted multi-account delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor refresh
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase, port the policy to SourceDeliveryPlan, update docs, and add real behavior proof on this PR.

options.title: Pause or close later
options.body: If no one can provide a clean branch and proof after the current review window, maintainers can close this PR while keeping the canonical issue available for a replacement fix.

recommendation.title: Replace on current main
recommendation.body: Rebuild the narrow fix on a maintainer-editable branch, credit this PR and the linked issue, and require live redacted multi-account delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent blame and hook/cron refactor history place this owner closest to the current main seams that the PR must target.
